description: Source code for a conversational retrieval QA chain component, including class definitions, chain creation functions, and memory management for a chat-based question-answering system built on langchain and related modules.

classes.name: ConversationalRetrievalQAChain_Chains

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the chain with input question, handling moderation, streaming, and memory updates.
